scenario.title: Nordvik's new customs broker
scenario.setting: A freight forwarder at Crossway Shipping whose assistant remembers customs broker instructions and repeated client routing preferences

items.text: Crossway Shipping's Gothenburg office coordinates all Nordic road freight.
Consignments over 3 tonnes need customs pre-clearance at least 48 hours before arrival at the destination.
Only customs brokers on Crossway's approved panel may file declarations for our clients.
Nordvik Timber's Oslo-bound consignments are cleared by customs broker Halden Customs, and the declarations are filed at the Gothenburg entry office.
Halden Customs and Stranda Customs are both on Crossway's approved broker panel.
A client's routing preferences may only be changed on written confirmation from that client.
Nordvik Timber ships a roughly 4-tonne consignment to Oslo every Thursday.
All Nordvik Oslo consignments are cleared through Halden Customs, pre-cleared at least 48 hours before arrival in Oslo.
The Gothenburg customs entry office accepts declaration filings between 08:00 and 12:00.
Nordvik's Oslo consignments are declared at the Gothenburg customs entry office, with filing done in the morning window.
Set up a standing customs slot for the Nordvik Oslo run: every Thursday at 10:00 with Halden Customs, with the declaration filed by noon on the preceding Tuesday.
All Danish-route consignments for client Byggmax Nord are cleared through broker Bredsjo Tull.
Crossway's pallet supplier is StenaPack in Borås.
Order 200 pallets from StenaPack on the first working day of each month.
Complete the annual audit of the approved broker panel. Done on 28 September.
New client Kollberg Chem ships solvents from Malmö to Hamburg twice a month.
Include Nordvik Timber's weekly volume in the Thursday KPI report sent to management.
Crossway's Gothenburg warehouse lease runs until June 2028 at 62,000 SEK per month.
Strand Logistics quoted 2,400 SEK per declaration for Oslo-route consignments, valid until 30 November; the quote has not been accepted.
Book the customs clearance slot for Nordvik Timber's Thursday 12 November Oslo consignment. Not done yet.
File the Q4 fuel surcharge report with the finance team. Not done yet.
